Its derivative is -1 and logarithmic decomposition has unit coefficient; Cauchy bound proves the exponentially small remainder. Strict root monotonicity and large-r rate follow from elementary integral comparisons. The standalone exact-rational checker exhaustively matches all recursive parent configurations through n=9 for r=2..6 (100 checks). No finite check is treated as proof of an infinite statement.

value.rationale: Absence of a fixed terminal fringe shape is a natural rare-event quantity for motif detection and recursive-tree compression, unaddressed by the usual central-limit description of the number of occurrences. The exact all-r enumeration, common zero-free disk, unit-prefactor exponential asymptotic with explicit error, strict rate ordering and large-r scale are a structural resolution rather than a numerical example or small parameter improvement.
